visualCharacteristics.summary: Brand-blue panel with a pinned display title; captions phase in around it and a video scales from a card to full-bleed behind it
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Tagline/brand-idea moments with a pinned lockup over scroll-scaled video

contentPattern.summary: Pinned 'Hits Different' lockup over a scroll-scaled video, with three eyebrow + caption pairs (Energy, impact, euphoria / Unique, playful, special / More than just a tagline)
contentPattern.structure: row 1 = link to the MP4 (or a picture); row 2 = eyebrow (<strong> paragraph) + caption pairs before the heading, the heading (title), then eyebrow + caption pairs after it; when there are 2+ pairs after the heading, the last one is the outro caption

usage: Pinned title over a ~12-viewport scroll track. Phases by scroll progress: intro (captions around the title, 0-20%), title alone (20-30%), video card grows to full-bleed and back (30-80%), outro caption (80-100%). Reduced motion: everything stacked statically, video with controls.
reuseGuidance: Tagline/brand-idea moments with a pinned lockup over scroll-scaled video
